_comment: Judgement decisions for services the deterministic classifier could not place. Each entry states who decided and why. method=llm means model judgement recorded for review; method=manual means a human decided. Delete an entry to hand the service back to the classifier.

overrides.reason: IAM Access Analyzer exists only to find unintended access and unused permissions. AWS documents it inside the IAM guide, so it has no product-directory entry of its own.
AWS Security Token Service issues temporary credentials. Its whole purpose is authentication.
The IAM Identity Center identity store holds users and groups for AWS access. It is an identity service.
The version 2 API of AWS CloudHSM. Same hardware security module service, separate IAM prefix.
Amazon Inspector Classic. A vulnerability assessment service, still a separate IAM prefix.
The Amazon Inspector Scan API scans a software bill of materials for vulnerabilities.
The telemetry data plane of Amazon Inspector. Its actions carry scan telemetry from the agent.
Amazon CodeGuru Security finds security defects in source code.
An AWS security service whose actions cover penetration tests, threat models, code reviews and security requirements.
AWS Network Security Director reports network security findings, resources, insights and remediations.
The AWS Private CA Connector for Active Directory issues certificates to domain-joined machines.
The AWS Private CA Connector for SCEP issues certificates to mobile and network devices.
AWS Payment Cryptography performs payment key management and cryptographic operations.
The data plane of AWS Payment Cryptography, which performs the cryptographic operations.
AWS Signer signs code so that it can be verified before it runs.
AWS WAF Classic. A web application firewall, kept as a separate IAM prefix.
The regional endpoint of AWS WAF Classic, for Application Load Balancers and API Gateway.
AWS Control Catalog publishes the common controls, domains and objectives that governance and compliance services draw on.
CloudTrail exists to record who did what in an account. Audit logging is a security function, and the AWS Security Reference Architecture lists it under threat detection.
AWS Config records resource configuration and evaluates it against rules. The AWS Security Reference Architecture lists it under threat detection and continuous monitoring.
Trusted Advisor publishes a security check category, but its purpose spans cost, performance and limits as well.
Service control policies and resource control policies are primary security controls, but the service itself manages accounts.
Control Tower applies security and compliance guardrails, but its purpose is landing zone governance.
EC2 carries security groups, network ACLs, EBS encryption, IMDSv2 and Nitro Enclaves, but it is a compute service.
S3 carries Block Public Access, bucket policies, default encryption and Object Lock, but it is a storage service.
Systems Manager carries Patch Manager and Session Manager, but its purpose is operations management.
Lambda carries resource policies, code signing and environment variable encryption, but it is a compute service.
AWS Backup carries vault lock and backup encryption, which protect against data destruction, but it is a data protection service rather than a security service.
VPC Lattice carries auth policies for service-to-service access, but it is a networking service.
Route 53 Resolver carries DNS Firewall, which the AWS Security Reference Architecture lists as a network protection service.
ECR carries image scanning, repository policies and encryption, but it is a registry service.
Lake Formation carries fine-grained data access control, but its purpose is data lake management.
Resource Explorer supports security work by inventorying resources, but it is a discovery service.
